newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela navy man named shipping channel head.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela navy man named shipping channel head.

text.p: President Rafael Caldera swore in Vice Admiral Gonzalo Jesus Gomez Monday as head of the National Channels Institute (INC).
The INC post has been in doubt since its previous holder Carlos Punar Abreu was sacked in March following a spate of tanker groundings in the country's main shipping channel.
In a long acceptance speech Gomez made no reference to the problems in the Lake Maracaibo shipping channel, where the Greek-flagged Nissos Amorgos ran aground, spilling 25,000 barrels of crude.
Tanker owners' organization Intertanko has said silting of the channel had caused the Nissos Amorgos to slow down, lose steerage and hit an underwater object.
